initial_failure: Three HTTP tests failed: approved drafts could be rejected/revised, and failed revision output was published.
fix: Condition pending revision/rejection on the exact scoped durable draft. Publish only successful revisions with a fresh approval ID and updated hash. Preserve original draft/history on failure.
coverage: approved plan refuses revision and rejection
delayed revision after rejection/approval/new revision refuses publication
concurrent revisions have one durable winner
old approval cannot consume revised draft
revision hash and history match saved draft
limits: Private SQL tests cover competing mutations; canonical browser covers original saved-plan recovery and duplicate approvals, not revision/rejection races. Broad engine results predate this patch. Claim-before-run process death, new plan-start ordering and full external-service reconciliation remain open. No production deployment or full acceptance claim.
